text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while preparing to head home after training…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Look. The stars are so pretty.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The breeze is so refreshing, and there's no one else on the track.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Would it be all right if I continued running a little?
choice_data_list: Go take in the night scenery.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Such a wonderful view… How could I not?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka spends the remainder of her available time running around the track beneath the starlit sky.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? I-is it that time already?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'll have to run home—Oh, well, I suppose I get to run either way…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka rushes off back to the dorms.
